sections: with a lot of light from the sun. The sunny weather is good for a walk.
a cooler, darker place away from direct sunlight. Let's sit in the shade of that tree.
a cream or lotion that protects skin from the sun. Put on sunscreen before you go outside.
a curved band of colors sometimes seen in the sky after rain. We see a rainbow above the houses.
the time in the morning when the sun first appears. We get up early to watch the sunrise.
